newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia, Kenya agree to counter border raids.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia, Kenya agree to counter border raids.

text.p: Ethiopia and Kenya agreed on Friday to prevent cross-border raids following the killing of 80 people in an attack by Ethiopian bandits on northern Kenya last month.
Ending a three-day meeting, officials of both countries said authorities and security agencies should increase vigilance and act against those suspected of cross-border raids and looting.

It said a team would be sent on April 14 to investigate the killing of Kenyans and Ethiopians last month. Kenyan police said Ethiopian bandits crossed into Kenya, butchered villagers and stole 4,000 cattle. Kenyan police and troops clashed with the rustlers.
The officials said they agreed to revive radio links between police and security officials at border posts and called on both sides to arrange "peace meetings" between border communities.
The two sides agreed to meet in Kenya in April next year.
